title: Blow-ups of order types of positive density
summary: Order types are an equivalence relation between point configurations that capture their combinatorial and convexity properties. Let $P$ be a $κ$-colored sequence of $n \ge d+1$ points in general position in $\mathbb{R}^d$. Let $ρ$ be a $κ$-colored order type on $k \le d+1$ points that has positive density on $P$; that is, for some constant $δ>0$, there are $δ\cdot \binom{n}{k}$ $k$-point subsequences of $P$ that have the same order type as $ρ$ and the same color pattern.
